title: 第二十三章 杀冲霄第二十四章 仙途洞府
content_zh:
罗冠抱紧许珂，猛地发力调转两人位置，下一刻他重重撞上河床，闷哼一声脸色发白。
两人钻出水面，许珂焦急道：“你没事吧？”
罗冠没回答，眼神落在她身上——追杀者已被甩掉，突然又锁定他们，唯一解释就是，许珂身上有可被追踪的东西。
确定这点，罗冠眼底闪过一丝犹豫。
他与许珂只见过两面，诚然她的确是一个，不逊色金雅的美女，但罗冠却不是色令智昏的糊涂蛋。
如今这世上，如今能让他不顾生死的，便只有父亲一人！
罗冠等了一下，没听到玄龟声音，便已明白它的意思。
“堕落月仆……看来，这女人的身份，很不简单！”深吸口气，罗冠面露坚毅，一颗倒在河道上的枯木，出现在视线中，他调整角度在交错而过瞬间，一拳打断枯木，牢牢抓住其中一截。
将许珂推到枯木上，他沉声道：“我们必须分开，才有机会将追杀者逐个击破，否则必死无疑。”
“抱紧别松手，我会回来救你！”一拳击中河堤，罗冠借力冲出水面，落地瞬间毫不犹豫冲向远方。
枯木上，许珂眼睁睁看着罗冠消失不见，用力咬住嘴唇，你……真的还会回来吗？她脸上流露苦涩，将这不切实际的念头压下，在河水冲击中，拼命抱紧木头。
刚生出一丝暖意的心脏，此刻再度封闭、沉寂。
唰——
两道身影落在河边，看向刚被打断的枯木，不远处地面，留有清晰的脚步印，一直消失在视线尽头。
周老沉声道：“他们分开逃了，那女人沿河向下，另一个人则逃往这个方向。”略一停顿，“这些脚印太清晰了，像是被人故意留下，生怕我们看不到，或许其中有诈。”
秦业摇头，“这两个人，无论哪个都不能放过！”他果断决定，“周老，你锁定那女人气息，继续沿河向下，我去追另外一人。”
周老眼底闪过一丝犹豫，“……好！”
嗖——
两人各自冲出。
山林中，罗冠感受到了，身后传来的强大气息。他心头微松，对方分开追了，若他们选择继续追杀许珂，事情就麻烦了。

“冲霄境……”
罗冠低语，下意识抿了抿嘴角，转身继续逃。
或许是因为长时间的逃亡，体力逐渐不支，前面那道身影逐渐慢了下来，秦业已经锁定住对方身影，他心中大定。
以冲霄境修为，只要找到对方，他便绝难逃脱。
突然，前方那道身影，似是脚下一滑，翻滚跌入山谷。
秦业眼神一亮，纵身跃入半空，横跨百米落在一颗树上，眼神笼罩眼前的山谷。许是因为地貌缘故，这里的树木相对低矮，他轻松可将整个山谷范围尽收眼底。
对方并未逃出，他就藏在这座山谷里！
秦业目光微微闪动，大声道：“这位朋友，秦家不愿与你身后势力交恶，只要你将偷走的钱袋还回来，我转身就走绝不再追击。”
说话时，他眼神敏锐的，注视着整个山谷。
可惜，没有半点动静传出。
秦业皱了皱眉，眼底有些犹豫，实在是之前许珂身化血月一幕，令他无比忌惮，谁知到这人是不是，也有类似底牌。
可对方不上当，那就只能冒险！
咬了咬牙，秦业走进山谷……放人走？当然不可能。
此人必须死！
凝神感知，秦业走的很慢，雨水、风声的侵扰被排除，任何一点异常都会被发现。可那人气息就像消失了一样，秦业脸色微变，莫非对方有某种特殊手段，已经悄悄逃走？
就在这时，他面前雨幕，突然从中分开，冰冷剑锋直刺面门。秦业瞳孔收缩，自这把长剑上感受到，极其恐怖的感觉。他爆喝一声，双手向前拍出，五指、掌心爆发出浓郁青光，与长剑重重碰撞。
一声巨响，秦业身影暴退，他两只手掌被贯穿，更有纵横交错无数道伤口翻卷，露出的下面的骨头，鲜血不断涌出。胸口处，衣袍变成粉碎，赫然浮现一道血线。
冷汗自额头冒出，他这位冲霄境大高手，竟差点被人一剑偷袭击杀！
这两个人，绝对来自帝都！
对面，罗冠被震飞出去，与冲霄境正面硬撼，实力间仍存在巨大悬殊。一个狼狈翻滚，他吐出一口鲜血，看了眼对面的秦业，仰头喝下玉瓶中的灵液，转身就逃。

“哪里走！”
眼看对方受创，秦业岂会放罗冠脱身，脚下一踏纵身冲来。
嗡——
content_en:
Luo Guan hugged Xu Ke tightly, and suddenly used force to change their positions. The next moment, he hit the river bed hard, groaning and turning pale.
The two came out of the water, and Xu Ke said anxiously: "Are you okay?"
Luo Guan didn't answer, his eyes fell on her - the pursuers had been thrown away, and suddenly they were targeted again. The only explanation was that there was something on Xu Ke that could be tracked.
Confirming this, a trace of hesitation flashed in Luo Guan's eyes.
He had only met Xu Ke twice. It was true that she was indeed a beauty who was not inferior to Jinya, but Luo Guan was not a fool who was so lustful that she was blinded by lust.
In this world now, the only one who can make him risk life and death is his father!
Luo Guan waited for a moment and understood what it meant before he heard the black turtle's voice.
"Fallen Moon Servant... It seems that this woman's identity is not simple!" Taking a deep breath, Luo Guan showed determination. A dead tree that had fallen on the river appeared in his sight. He adjusted his angle as they passed by, broke the dead tree with a punch, and firmly grasped a section of it.
Pushing Xu Ke onto the dead wood, he said solemnly: "We must separate to have a chance to defeat the pursuers one by one, otherwise we will definitely die."
"Hold tight and don't let go, I will come back to save you!" A punch hit the river embankment, Luo Guan used the force to rush out of the water, and rushed into the distance without hesitation the moment he landed.
On the dead wood, Xu Ke watched Luo Guan disappear, biting his lip hard, will you... really come back? With bitterness on her face, she suppressed the unrealistic thought and hugged the wood as hard as she could under the impact of the river water.
The heart that had just felt warm was now closed and silent again.
Swish——
Two figures landed by the river and looked at the dead wood that had just been broken. There were clear footsteps on the ground not far away, which disappeared at the end of the line of sight.
Mr. Zhou said in a deep voice: "They ran away separately. The woman went down the river, and the other person fled in this direction." After a slight pause, "These footprints are too clear, as if they were left deliberately, for fear that we wouldn't be able to see them. Maybe there is a trick in them."
Qin Ye shook his head, "No one of these two people can be let go!" He decided decisively, "Mr. Zhou, lock on to that woman's aura and continue down the river. I'll chase the other one."
A trace of hesitation flashed in Mr. Zhou's eyes, "...Okay!"
Whoosh——
The two of them rushed out separately.
In the mountain forest, Luo Guan felt the powerful aura coming from behind him. He felt slightly relieved, as the other party chased him separately. If they chose to continue chasing Xu Ke, things would be in trouble.
"Sky Sky Realm..."
Luo Guan whispered, subconsciously pursed his lips, turned around and continued to run away.
Perhaps because of the long period of running away, his physical strength was gradually exhausted, and the figure in front gradually slowed down. Qin Ye had already locked onto the other figure, and he was determined.
With his cultivation in the Sky Realm, as long as he finds the other party, it will be impossible for him to escape.
Suddenly, the figure in front seemed to slip and tumble into the valley.
Qin Ye's eyes lit up, he jumped into the air, and landed on a tree across a hundred meters, his eyes covering the valley in front of him. Perhaps because of the landform, the trees here were relatively low, and he could easily have a panoramic view of the entire valley.
The other party didn't escape, he was hiding in this valley!
Qin Ye's eyes flashed slightly and he said loudly: "My friend, the Qin family does not want to antagonize the forces behind you. As long as you return the stolen money bag, I will turn around and leave and never pursue you again."
As he spoke, his eyes were sharp and he looked at the entire valley.
Unfortunately, no movement was heard.
Qin Ye frowned, with some hesitation in his eyes. In fact, the scene where Xu Ke turned into a blood moon made him extremely afraid. Who knows if this person also has similar trump cards.
But if the other party is not fooled, then you can only take risks!
Gritting his teeth, Qin Ye walked into the valley...let him go? Of course it's impossible.
This man must die!
With concentration, Qin Ye walked very slowly. The intrusion of rain and wind was eliminated, and any abnormality would be discovered. But that personThe breath seemed to have disappeared, and Qin Ye's face changed slightly. Could it be that the other party had some special means and had quietly escaped?
At this moment, the rain curtain in front of him suddenly parted, and the cold sword pointed directly at his face. Qin Ye's pupils shrank, and he felt an extremely terrifying feeling from this long sword. He shouted loudly, slapping his hands forward, and a rich green light burst out from his five fingers and palms, colliding heavily with the sword.
With a loud noise, Qin Ye retreated violently, his two palms were penetrated, and there were countless criss-crossing wounds, exposing the bones underneath, and blood continued to gush out. On the chest, the robe was shattered into pieces, and a line of blood suddenly appeared.
Cold sweat broke out on his forehead. He, a master of the Sky Realm, was almost killed by a sneak attack with a sword!
These two people are definitely from the imperial capital!
On the opposite side, Luo Guan was blown away and faced off against the Sky Realm head-on. There was still a huge disparity in strength. He rolled around in embarrassment, spit out a mouthful of blood, glanced at Qin Ye opposite him, raised his head and drank the spiritual liquid in the jade bottle, turned around and ran away.
"Where to go!"
Seeing that the other party was injured, how could Qin Ye let Luo Guan escape? He stepped forward and rushed towards him.
Buzz——
